checks.name: the branch is worth having — some off-book policy beats clean
checks.detail: clean 264.3; beaten by one_off 472.5, burst 420.9, shell 346.7, shell2 278.6

checks.name: off-book gross does not climb the CHARTER ladder
checks.detail: charter gross p50 — clean 168087.5, all_off 0 (0 % of it)

checks.name: running everything off the books gets the charter suspended
checks.detail: suspensions per 90 min — all_off 2, burst 0, clean 0

checks.name: a shell charter keeps the legit charter cool, and that is what a second company buys
checks.detail: legit charter's PEAK exposure — shell 0 (WATCH is 0.2), one_off 0.3. The SAME driver (roster slot 0) is running in both arms; the only difference is which charter they are registered to.

checks.name: the shell is priced, and what it buys is a legit charter with NOTHING on its file
checks.detail:
legit pay lost to exposure — shell 0, one_off 1242
      legit charter's peak file — shell 0, one_off 0.3
      founding fees paid — shell 10200, one_off 3000
      NET is deliberately NOT asserted here: shell 346.7 vs one_off 472.5 against a p10-p90 spread of 366 on the shell arm alone — the difference is smaller than its own noise and is reported, not banked

checks.name: a shell can never hold more than one driver, and that is a consequence not a rule
checks.detail: a charter with 5,000,000 CRD of OFF-BOOK gross and 900 deliveries on it has driverCap 1 — still SOLE TRADER, because TWO-HANDED needs 18000 of CHARTER gross and a run does not produce any

checks.name: running the branch on your ONLY charter costs you the driver cap, and that compounds
checks.detail: after 90 min from SOLE TRADER — clean reached charter tier 3 with 3 drivers hired; first_off reached tier 1 with 1. The cap is a company tier, company tiers are reached on CHARTER gross, and a run produces none — so the naive policy freezes its own fleet.

checks.name: a shell buys a hull the charter’s own cap could not have carried
checks.detail: shell ends with 4 drivers across 2 charters against clean's 3 across 1; its legit charter still reached tier 3 (clean 3) with a file reading 0. last_off, which runs the same one driver on the ONE charter, ends at tier 3 with a file of 0.3.
